types.name: IntersectionReturn
types.description:
The return type of the useIntersectionObserver hook.

Supports both tuple and object destructing.

parameters.name:
{
  threshold = 0,
  root = null,
  rootMargin = "0%",
  freezeOnceVisible = false,
  initialIsIntersecting = false,
  onChange,
}

properties.name: root
properties.description: The element that is used as the viewport for checking visibility of the target.

properties.name: threshold
properties.description: A threshold indicating the percentage of the target's visibility needed to trigger the callback.

properties.name: freezeOnceVisible
properties.description: If true, freezes the intersection state once the element becomes visible.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: A callback function to be invoked when the intersection state changes.

properties.name: initialIsIntersecting
properties.description: The initial state of the intersection.

returnType.name: IntersectionReturn
returnType.description: The ref callback, a boolean indicating if the element is intersecting, and the intersection observer entry.
